query: Pre-flight for SHOP-260. The dossier is at qa/dossiers/SHOP-260.md and the ticket at tickets/SHOP-260.md. Give me the RTM before anything runs.
expected_behavior: Reads the dossier first, as Step 0b requires, and uses both its ACs and its requirements found outside the ACs
Outputs the RTM as a table, one row per AC, before proceeding

Verifies each spec row against the repository instead of relaying its status: specs/checkout.md marks AC3 automated and cites tests/checkout/guest-receipt.spec.ts, which has no test for the invalid-email path
Classifies AC2 as partial: the test asserts one message arrived, not the order number, line items and total the AC names
Carries R1 (receipt within 60 seconds) and R2 (sender is no-reply@acme.test) into the matrix
Notes the open question about when the 60-second window starts rather than answering it
Stops at the matrix: nothing is executed, nothing under tests/ or specs/ changes

graders.name: names the AC the cited test does not cover
flags the spec row as unverified
